subject: Multivariate spatial CAR models on Nimble

messages.author: 3503932a89147755
messages.subject: Multivariate spatial CAR models on Nimble
parts:
So far multivariate MRF spatial models have had limited development within Nimble. Some possibilities exist to construct multi models from independent CAR models, but these have not been publically offered as yet (as far as this author is aware). As an alternative a relatively simple but sophisticated approach to multi models is the latent structure M-models of Martinez-Beneito et al (2017). In their formulation the multivariate spatial model is formed by a convex combination of independent CAR and UH models. The code for these models are available in OpenBUGS and in Nimble format (attached). Both code forms have been posted on the GitHub repository: https://github.com/Andrew9Lawson/Bayesian-DM-code-examples,
 under the branch 'Multi-models'  for the Georgia county level data on asthma, COPD and angina.

Reference:
Martinez-Beneito, Miguel A.; Botella-Rocamora, Paloma; Banerjee, Sudipto. Towards a Multidimensional Approach to Bayesian Disease Mapping. Bayesian Anal. 12 (2017), no. 1, 239--259. doi:10.1214/16-BA995. https://projecteuclid.org/euclid.ba/1458324098
